title: Language specialization delegates eligibility to the shared selector

claims.text: specialize builds the agent_specialize command via _command, then its prepare callback returns _birth_payload with op='specialize' and the requested language.
specialize imposes no independent eligibility rule of its own; the shared selector reachable through _birth_payload and _transact decides admission.
specialize returns _transact(effective, prepare, ctx), the committed birth result for the specialized child agent.

triggers: language specialized agent born with wrong inheritance

decision.rule: Change here when language specialization birth payload, command name or eligibility delegation needs to change.
decision.failure: A specialized child is born without the requested language, or specialization bypasses the shared selector rules.

questions.q: Where does specialize build its birth payload with op specialize and the language?
Where should I change how specialize delegates eligibility to the shared selector?
Where can I debug why a specialized child was born with the wrong language?
